newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chiyoda Life sees profits lost if Nikkei at 17,700.
newsitem.headline: Chiyoda Life sees profits lost if Nikkei at 17,700.

text.p: Chiyoda Mutual Life Insurance Co will lose its unrealised profits from stock holdings if the Nikkei stock average falls to 17,700, a company official said on Monday.
The Nikkei on Monday closed at 20,223.82, down 261.93 or 1.28 percent.
He added that the company plans 50 billion yen worth of fresh investment in foreign bonds in fiscal 1997/98, which started on April 1.

The official also said the company plans 100 to 200 billion yen of new investment in domestic bonds in the same period, but intends to reduce its investment in stocks by 100 to 200 billion yen. Monday, 9 June 1997 07:38:11 ENDS nTAS004591
